1: // Game based on IDEA.md – Meteor Dodge
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
6: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
7: 
8: // ----- Player -----
9: const ship = {
10:   x: canvas.width / 2,
11:   y: canvas.height / 2,
12:   r: 12,
13:   angle: 0,
14:   vx: 0,
15:   vy: 0,
16:   thrust: 0.1,
17:   rotSpeed: 0.08,
18:   fuel: 100,
19: };
20: 
21: // ----- Input -----
22: const keys = {};
23: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
24: window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
25: 
26: // ----- Meteors -----
27: const meteors = [];
28: function spawnMeteor() {
29:   const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
30:   let x, y, vx, vy;
31:   const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 1.5 + meteors.length * 0.02;
32:   if (edge === 0) { // top
33:     x = Math.random() * canvas.width; y = -20; vx = (canvas.width/2 - x) * 0.001; vy = speed;
34:   } else if (edge === 1) { // bottom
35:     x = Math.random() * canvas.width; y = canvas.height + 20; vx = (canvas.width/2 - x) * 0.001; vy = -speed;
36:   } else if (edge === 2) { // left
37:     x = -20; y = Math.random() * canvas.height; vx = speed; vy = (canvas.height/2 - y) * 0.001;
38:   } else { // right
39:     x = canvas.width + 20; y = Math.random() * canvas.height; vx = -speed; vy = (canvas.height/2 - y) * 0.001;
40:   }
41:   meteors.push({x, y, vx, vy, r: 15 + Math.random()*10});
42: }
43: let meteorTimer = 0;
44: 
45: // ----- Fuel Canisters -----
46: const fuels = [];
47: function spawnFuel() {
48:   const x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
49:   const y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
50:   fuels.push({x, y, r: 8});
51: }
52: let fuelTimer = 0;
53: 
54: function update(dt) {
55:   // Controls
56:   if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.angle -= ship.rotSpeed;
57:   if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.angle += ship.rotSpeed;
58:   if (keys.ArrowUp && ship.fuel > 0) {
59:     ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
60:     ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
61:     ship.fuel -= 0.05;
62:   }
63:   // Move ship
64:   ship.x += ship.vx; ship.y += ship.vy;
65:   // Simple friction
66:   ship.vx *= 0.99; ship.vy *= 0.99;
67:   // Keep inside canvas (wrap)
68:   if (ship.x < 0) ship.x = canvas.width;
69:   if (ship.x > canvas.width) ship.x = 0;
70:   if (ship.y < 0) ship.y = canvas.height;
71:   if (ship.y > canvas.height) ship.y = 0;
72: 
73:   // Meteors
74:   meteorTimer += dt;
75:   if (meteorTimer > 1000) { spawnMeteor(); meteorTimer = 0; }
76:   meteors.forEach(m => { m.x += m.vx; m.y += m.vy; });
77:   // Remove off‑screen meteors
78:   for (let i = meteors.length-1; i>=0; i--) {
79:     const m = meteors[i];
80:     if (m.x < -50 || m.x > canvas.width+50 || m.y < -50 || m.y > canvas.height+50) meteors.splice(i,1);
81:   }
82: 
83:   // Fuel canisters
84:   fuelTimer += dt;
85:   if (fuelTimer > 5000) { spawnFuel(); fuelTimer = 0; }
86:   // Collision ship‑fuel
87:   for (let i = fuels.length-1; i>=0; i--) {
88:     const f = fuels[i];
89:     const d = Math.hypot(ship.x-f.x, ship.y-f.y);
90:     if (d < ship.r + f.r) { ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + 30); fuels.splice(i,1); }
91:   }
92: 
93:   // Collision ship‑meteor
94:   for (const m of meteors) {
95:     const d = Math.hypot(ship.x-m.x, ship.y-m.y);
96:     if (d < ship.r + m.r) { gameOver(); return; }
97:   }
98: }
99: 
100: let score = 0;
101: let lastTime = performance.now();
102: let running = true;
103: function gameOver() {
104:   running = false;
105:   alert(`Game Over! Score: ${Math.floor(score)}s`);
106: }
107: 
108: function draw() {
109:   ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
110:   ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
111: 
112:   // Ship
113:   ctx.save();
114:   ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
115:   ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
116:   ctx.beginPath();
117:   ctx.moveTo(ship.r,0);
118:   ctx.lineTo(-ship.r/2, ship.r/2);
119:   ctx.lineTo(-ship.r/2, -ship.r/2);
120:   ctx.closePath();
121:   ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
122:   ctx.fill();
123:   ctx.restore();
124: 
125:   // Meteors
126:   ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
127:   for (const m of meteors) {
128:     ctx.beginPath();
129:     ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
130:     ctx.fill();
131:   }
132: 
133:   // Fuel canisters
134:   ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
135:   for (const f of fuels) {
136:     ctx.beginPath();
137:     ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
138:     ctx.fill();
139:   }
140: 
141:   // HUD
142:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
143:   ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
144:   ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.floor(ship.fuel)}`, 10, 20);
145:   ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}s`, 10, 40);
146: }
147: 
148: function loop(now) {
149:   const dt = now - lastTime;
150:   lastTime = now;
151:   if (running) {
152:     update(dt);
153:     score += dt/1000;
154:     draw();
155:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
156:   }
157: }
158: requestAnimationFrame(loop);

(End of file - total 158 lines)
